During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorta/Legends|Lorta]] when Republic forces attacked the [[D-1Z prototype bomber]] on its maiden voyage. Imperial forces successfully defended the [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==The battle==
Escorted by a pair of [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]], the D-1Z prototype bomber was on its maiden voyage above Lorta when the group of Imperial ships was ambushed by a trio of [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]. The Empire's Fury arrived moments later, strafing and heavily damaging the Republic frigates whilst protecting the bomber. The Republic subsequently arrived in full force when a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]], escorted by two additional Thranta frigates, joined the battle. Despite their superior numbers, the Republic forces were unable to destroy the prototype bomber before it escaped to hyperspace. Imperial reinforcements consisting of two more Terminus destroyers flanked the Republic fleet and, together with the Empire's Fury squadron, inflicted heavy damage. Despite destroying at least four frigates and the majority of the Republic fighters as well as all three [[Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class light corvettes]], the Imperial fleet opted for a safe retreat, jumping to hyperspace before taking heavy losses themselves.
